  7.2 Change Policy                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  PROHIBITED without major version bump:                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  - ❌ Changing field order in structs                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  - ❌ Changing encoding formats (byte layout)                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - ❌ Modifying golden vectors                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  - ❌ Changing key prefixes (e.g., b"accounts/")                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  - ❌ Removing public functions                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - ❌ Changing function signatures                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ALLOWED:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  - ✅ Bug fixes preserving behavior                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  - ✅ Performance optimizations (internal only)                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - ✅ Documentation updates                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - ✅ New functions (additive only)                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  - ✅ New version variants (V2) with V1 backward compatibility

  8. Lessons Learned                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  8.1 Week 12 Was a "Verification Week" Not "Development Week"                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Insight: No new code was written. Week 12 validated that Weeks 1-11 were production-ready.                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Evidence:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  - All 330 tests existed before Week 12                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  - 105 chaos tests were from Week 10                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  - Documentation crystallized existing architecture                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  8.2 Interface Freeze Prevents Technical Debt                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Insight: Documenting interfaces before AI primitives (Weeks 13+) ensures clean separation of concerns.                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Benefit: AI features can be added without modifying the base chain → reduces risk of consensus bugs.                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  8.3 Chaos Testing Caught Zero Issues                                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Insight: 105 chaos tests passed on first run, indicating Weeks 6-10 were well-architected.                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Tests Executed:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  - 17 Byzantine behavior scenarios                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  - 16 crash recovery scenarios                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  - 16 partition scenarios                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  - 19 network fault scenarios (latency, packet loss)                                                                                                                                                                                             
  - 15 invariant checks                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - 7 framework tests                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  - 15 automated chaos runner tests

## Week 13: AI Signal Spec v1 and Approval Gate Framework

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  1. Week 13 Overview - Objectives & Deliverables                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Mission: Make AI signals first-class protocol objects and define the approval gate system that governs AI-triggered actions.                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Deliverables Committed:                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  - D13.1: AI Signals Specification (docs/AI_SIGNALS_V1.md)                                                                                                                                                                                       
  - D13.2: Signal Attack Model Documentation                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - D13.3: Approval Gate Types (gates.rs)                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  - D13.4: Tiering Engine (tiers.rs)                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  - D13.5: Gate Codec + Golden Vectors (gate_codec.rs)                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Scope: Framework and type definitions only - no state storage or consensus integration this week. Production-quality code establishing foundations for AI governance.                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  2. What Went Well                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Clean Architecture with Clear Invariants                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Every module was designed with explicit invariants documented in the file header:                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  //! INVARIANTS:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  //! - Every ActionType maps to exactly one ActionTier                                                                                                                                                                                           
  //! - tier_for_action() is exhaustive and total (no panics)                                                                                                                                                                                     
  //! - Tier 0 actions are NEVER executable by AI entities                                                                                                                                                                                        
  (tiers.rs:7-10)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This upfront documentation ensured no ambiguity during implementation.                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Compile-Time Safety for Tier Classification                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The tier_for_action() function uses exhaustive pattern matching, guaranteeing a compile error if new action types are added without classification:                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub const fn tier_for_action(action: &ActionType) -> ActionTier {                                                                                                                                                                               
      match action {                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
          ActionType::ModifyConsensusRule => ActionTier::Tier0Never,                                                                                                                                                                              
          ActionType::ModifyStateTransition => ActionTier::Tier0Never,                                                                                                                                                                            
          ActionType::UpdateBaseFee => ActionTier::Tier1High,                                                                                                                                                                                     
          // ... all variants explicitly handled                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  (tiers.rs:237-252)                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Content-Addressable Gate IDs                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Gate identifiers are deterministically computed from parameters using domain-separated hashing:                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  const GATE_ID_DOMAIN: &[u8] = b"NOVAI_APPROVAL_GATE_ID_V1";                                                                                                                                                                                     
  (gates.rs:22)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  hasher.update(GATE_ID_DOMAIN);                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  hasher.update(&[gate_type.to_byte()]);                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  hasher.update(&threshold.to_be_bytes());                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  (gates.rs:363-369)                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This makes gates content-addressable and collision-resistant.                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Automatic Approver Canonicalization                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Gates automatically sort approvers on construction, ensuring deterministic encoding:                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  let mut sorted_approvers = required_approvers;                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  sorted_approvers.sort();                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  (gates.rs:319-320)                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  3. Challenges We Faced                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 1: Golden Vector Test Buffer Size                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The decode_rejects_too_many_approvers test initially failed because our crafted test buffer was too short to reach the approver count validation.                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Symptom:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  assertion failed: matches!(result, Err(GateCodecError::TooManyApprovers { .. }))                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The buffer hit BufferTooShort before reaching the TooManyApprovers check.                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 2: Byte Order Consistency                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Initial design proposed little-endian (matching ai_entity_codec.rs), but the developer specified big-endian for gate codec to match blockchain protocol standards.                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 3: TimelockOnly Gate Semantics                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  TimelockOnly gates don't require signatures, creating a special case where threshold = 0 is valid but required_approvers should be empty.                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  4. How We Overcame Them                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 1: Complete Test Buffer Construction                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We constructed a full minimum-size buffer (59 bytes) to ensure the test reaches the correct validation path:                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  let mut buf = vec![APPROVAL_GATE_V1]; // version (1)                                                                                                                                                                                            
  buf.extend_from_slice(&[0u8; 32]);    // gate_id (32)                                                                                                                                                                                           
  buf.push(GateType::Multisig.to_byte()); // gate_type (1)                                                                                                                                                                                        
  let huge_count = (MAX_APPROVERS + 1) as u32;                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  buf.extend_from_slice(&huge_count.to_be_bytes()); // count (4)                                                                                                                                                                                  
  buf.extend_from_slice(&1u32.to_be_bytes());  // threshold (4)                                                                                                                                                                                   
  buf.extend_from_slice(&100u64.to_be_bytes()); // timelock (8)                                                                                                                                                                                   
  buf.extend_from_slice(&1000u64.to_be_bytes()); // expiry (8)                                                                                                                                                                                    
  buf.push(0x00); // flags (1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  assert_eq!(buf.len(), APPROVAL_GATE_V1_MIN_SIZE);                                                                                                                                                                                               
  (gate_codec.rs:565-581)                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 2: Explicit Wire Format Documentation                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Documented big-endian encoding clearly in the module header:                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  //! ENCODING FORMAT (big-endian integers, variable length):                                                                                                                                                                                     
  //! | Offset | Size | Field           | Notes          |                                                                                                                                                                                        
  //! |--------|------|-----------------|----------------|                                                                                                                                                                                        
  //! | 0      | 1    | version         | 0x01 for V1    |                                                                                                                                                                                        
  //! | 34     | 4    | approvers_count | u32 BE         |                                                                                                                                                                                        
  (gate_codec.rs:7-14)                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 3: Type-Specific Validation Rules                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Implemented conditional validation based on gate type:                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  match self.gate_type {                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
      GateType::Multisig | GateType::Threshold => {                                                                                                                                                                                               
          if self.threshold == 0 {                                                                                                                                                                                                                
              return Err(GateValidationError::ZeroThreshold);                                                                                                                                                                                     
          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      GateType::TimelockOnly => {                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
          if !self.required_approvers.is_empty() {                                                                                                                                                                                                
              return Err(GateValidationError::TimelockOnlyWithApprovers { count });                                                                                                                                                               
          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  (gates.rs - validation logic)

  Gate Types Implemented                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub enum GateType {                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      Multisig = 0,      // N-of-M signatures required                                                                                                                                                                                            
      Threshold = 1,     // At least N signatures                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      TimelockOnly = 2,  // Auto-approved after delay                                                                                                                                                                                             
  }

  pub enum ActionTier {                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      Tier0Never = 0,    // NEVER allowed via AI                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      Tier1High = 1,     // High security gates required                                                                                                                                                                                          
      Tier2Medium = 2,   // Moderate gates required                                                                                                                                                                                               
      Tier3Low = 3,      // Minimal approval needed

  Attack Model Documented                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  5 attack vectors analyzed in AI_SIGNALS_V1.md:                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - Poisoning Attack (malicious signals)                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  - Sybil Attack (entity flooding)                                                                                                                                                                                                                
  - False Positive Attack (false alarms)                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  - Timing Attack (strategic timing)                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  - Replay Attack (rebroadcasting old signals)

## Week 14: Signal Commitment Tx and On-Chain Indexing

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  1. Overview - Objectives & Deliverables                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Week Goal: Enable AI entities to publish signal commitments on-chain with efficient querying capabilities.                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Deliverables:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  - D14.1: TxPayload::PublishSignalCommitment with signal_hash, signal_type, issuer_entity_id                                                                                                                                                     
  - D14.2: Validation rules (issuer registered, has emit_proposals capability, valid signal type 0-6, sufficient balance, correct nonce)                                                                                                          
  - D14.3: State storage at ai_signal_key(height, issuer)                                                                                                                                                                                         
  - D14.4: Secondary indexes for efficient queries (by_type, by_issuer)                                                                                                                                                                           
  - D14.5: RPC endpoints: getSignalsByHeight, getSignalsByIssuer, getSignalsByType                                                                                                                                                                
  - D14.6: AI economic agency (fee deduction, nonce update, last_active_at)                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  2. What Went Well                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Clean payload structure (D14.1):                                                                                                                                                                                                                
  The signal commitment payload uses the established 66-byte canonical format:                                                                                                                                                                    
  pub const SIGNAL_COMMITMENT_PAYLOAD_V1: u8 = 2;                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  // Format: [version:1][signal_hash:32][signal_type:1][issuer_entity_id:32]                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Comprehensive validation chain (D14.2):                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  Validation follows defense-in-depth with clear error types:                                                                                                                                                                                     
  IssuerNotFound,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  IssuerMissingCapability,                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  IssuerMismatch,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Deterministic secondary indexing (D14.4):                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  Big-endian height encoding ensures lexicographic ordering matches height ordering:                                                                                                                                                              
  k.extend_from_slice(&height.to_be_bytes());                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Atomic state updates:                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  All state changes (commitment, indexes, entity update) are batched atomically:                                                                                                                                                                  
  db.apply_batch(&ops).map_err(ExecError::Db)?;                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Clean test architecture:                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Test file has clear sections mapped to acceptance criteria:                                                                                                                                                                                     
  // Acceptance Criterion 1: Tx accepted - Valid signal commitment processed                                                                                                                                                                      
  // Acceptance Criterion 2: Tx rejected - Invalid issuer rejected                                                                                                                                                                                
  // Acceptance Criterion 3: Indexed correctly - Queries return correct results                                                                                                                                                                   
  // Acceptance Criterion 4: Fee deducted - AI entity balance decreases                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  3. Challenges We Faced                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 1: Kv trait lacked range query support                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The initial Kv trait only supported point lookups. Implementing getSignalsByHeight required scanning all signals at a height:                                                                                                                   
  fn get(&self, key: &[u8]) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>, Self::Error>;                                                                                                                                                                              
  This was insufficient for the RPC requirement "RPC returns correct results."                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 2: Missing dependencies                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The execution crate needed novai-codec for signal encoding:                                                                                                                                                                                     
  error: use of unresolved module or unlinked crate 'novai_codec'                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The node crate needed novai-ai-entities for signal type conversions:                                                                                                                                                                            
  error: use of unresolved module or unlinked crate 'novai_ai_entities'                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 3: Test helper incomplete                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The FaultyKv test helper in atomic_batch.rs needed the new trait method:                                                                                                                                                                        
  error: not all trait items implemented, missing: 'scan_prefix'                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 4: Primary key uniqueness constraint                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Initial test assumed multiple signals from same issuer at same height. The key design ai_signal_key(height, issuer) only allows one:                                                                                                            
  pub fn ai_signal_key(height: u64, issuer: &[u8; 32]) -> Vec<u8>                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  4. How We Overcame Them                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 1: Added scan_prefix to Kv trait                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Extended the trait with consensus-safe prefix scanning:                                                                                                                                                                                         
  fn scan_prefix(&self, prefix: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)>, Self::Error>;                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Implemented in MemKv with deterministic sorting:                                                                                                                                                                                                
  results.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.cmp(&b.0));                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 2: Added missing Cargo dependencies                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Added to execution/Cargo.toml:                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  novai-codec = { path = "../codec", version = "0.1.0" }                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Added to node/Cargo.toml:                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  novai-ai-entities = { path = "../ai_entities", version = "0.1.0" }                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 3: Implemented scan_prefix for FaultyKv                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Added minimal implementation to test helper:                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  fn scan_prefix(&self, _prefix: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)>, Self::Error> {                                                                                                                                                         
      Ok(Vec::new())                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 4: Redesigned test to use multiple issuers                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Changed test to create two entities for same-height testing:                                                                                                                                                                                    
  let entity1 = create_test_entity([0x01u8; 32], 10000, 0);                                                                                                                                                                                       
  let entity2 = create_test_entity([0x02u8; 32], 10000, 0);                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---
