## Week 15: Off-Chain Artifact Storage for AI Signals

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  1. Overview - Objectives & Deliverables                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Goal: Implement content-addressed storage for AI signal payloads that are too expensive to store on-chain. On-chain transactions store only a 32-byte commitment hash; the full payload lives off-chain.                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Deliverables:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  - D15.1: ArtifactStore trait - Generic interface for content-addressed storage                                                                                                                                                                  
  - D15.2: LocalFileStore - File-based implementation with atomic writes                                                                                                                                                                          
  - D15.3: HttpFetchStore - HTTP-based fetching with multi-mirror support (feature-gated)                                                                                                                                                         
  - D15.4: SignalPayload - Structured format for AI signal data with canonical encoding                                                                                                                                                           
  - D15.5: Verification flow - Hash verification with constant-time comparison                                                                                                                                                                    
  - D15.6: MemoryValue enum - Flexible inline/artifact storage for AI memory                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  2. What Went Well                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Clean Architecture with Trait Abstraction                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We designed a flexible storage interface that supports multiple backends:                                                                                                                                                                       
  pub trait ArtifactStore {                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      fn store(&mut self, content: &[u8]) -> Result<[u8; 32], ArtifactError>;                                                                                                                                                                     
      fn fetch(&self, hash: &[u8; 32]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ArtifactError>;                                                                                                                                                                         
      fn exists(&self, hash: &[u8; 32]) -> bool;                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Domain-Separated Hashing                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  All artifact hashes use domain separation to prevent cross-protocol collisions:                                                                                                                                                                 
  const ARTIFACT_HASH_DOMAIN_V1: &[u8] = b"NOVAI_ARTIFACT_V1";                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Atomic File Writes                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  LocalFileStore prevents partial writes using write-then-rename:                                                                                                                                                                                 
  std::fs::write(&temp_path, content)?;                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  std::fs::rename(&temp_path, &path)?;                                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Smart Memory Storage with Auto-Sizing                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  MemoryValue automatically chooses inline vs artifact based on size:                                                                                                                                                                             
  if data.len() <= MAX_INLINE_MEMORY_SIZE {                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      MemoryValue::Inline(data)                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  } else {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      MemoryValue::Artifact(artifact_hash(&data))                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Security-First Verification                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Hash comparison uses constant-time equality to prevent timing attacks:                                                                                                                                                                          
  fn constant_time_eq(a: &[u8; 32], b: &[u8; 32]) -> bool {                                                                                                                                                                                       
      let mut result = 0u8;                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      for (x, y) in a.iter().zip(b.iter()) {                                                                                                                                                                                                      
          result |= x ^ y;                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      result == 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  3. Challenges We Faced                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 1: Golden Vector Hash Mismatches                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Initial golden vector tests failed because the expected hashes were placeholder values:                                                                                                                                                         
  assertion `left == right` failed: Hash must not change                                                                                                                                                                                          
    left: "82893ff1a1d3532a596390fa5753a8e207c5f64077812fb1017e5d427badccbb"                                                                                                                                                                      
   right: "7e9d5f3fc5c80ed5e6891d1e60d61cd3dff39b62a0c35ac6a8e08e7f71e9c2b4"                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 2: Integration Test File Path Mismatch                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Corruption detection test failed because it used wrong file extension:                                                                                                                                                                          
  // Wrong: files stored with .bin extension                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  let file_path = temp_dir.path().join(&hash_hex);                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 3: ArtifactError Pattern Matching                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Test used unit variant pattern for tuple variant:                                                                                                                                                                                               
  error[E0532]: expected unit struct, found tuple variant `ArtifactError::NotFound`                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  4. How We Overcame Them                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Fix 1: Updated Golden Vectors with Computed Hashes                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Ran tests to get actual hash values, then locked them:                                                                                                                                                                                          
  let expected_hex = "82893ff1a1d3532a596390fa5753a8e207c5f64077812fb1017e5d427badccbb";                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Fix 2: Corrected File Path Format                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Used the actual .bin extension that LocalFileStore uses:                                                                                                                                                                                        
  let file_path = temp_dir.path().join(format!("{}.bin", hash_hex));                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Fix 3: Proper Pattern Matching for Tuple Variants                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Added wildcard for the hash field:                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  matches!(result, Err(FetchVerifyError::Artifact(ArtifactError::NotFound(_))))

Code Evidence                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  D15.1: ArtifactStore Trait (artifacts.rs:93-115)                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub trait ArtifactStore {                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      fn store(&mut self, content: &[u8]) -> Result<[u8; 32], ArtifactError>;                                                                                                                                                                     
      fn fetch(&self, hash: &[u8; 32]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ArtifactError>;                                                                                                                                                                         
      fn exists(&self, hash: &[u8; 32]) -> bool;                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  D15.2: LocalFileStore Hash Verification (artifacts.rs:241-248)                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  let actual_hash = artifact_hash(&content);                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  if actual_hash != *hash {                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      return Err(ArtifactError::HashMismatch { expected: *hash, actual: actual_hash });                                                                                                                                                           
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  D15.4: SignalPayload Structure (payload.rs:32-43)                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub struct SignalPayload {                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
      pub model_id: String,                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      pub model_version: String,                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      pub input_summary: String,                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      pub output_data: Vec<u8>,

  D15.5: Verification Flow (verify.rs:54-66)                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub fn verify_payload_hash(payload_bytes: &[u8], expected_hash: &[u8; 32]) -> VerifyResult {                                                                                                                                                    
      let actual_hash = artifact_hash(payload_bytes);                                                                                                                                                                                             
      if constant_time_eq(&actual_hash, expected_hash) {                                                                                                                                                                                          
          VerifyResult::Valid                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
      } else {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
          VerifyResult::HashMismatch { expected: *expected_hash, actual: actual_hash }                                                                                                                                                            
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  D15.6: MemoryValue Enum (verify.rs:123-128)                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub enum MemoryValue {                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
      Inline(Vec<u8>),      // ≤256 bytes stored directly                                                                                                                                                                                         
      Artifact([u8; 32]),   // >256 bytes stored as artifact reference                                                                                                                                                                            
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  End-to-End Test (artifact_integration.rs:361-401)                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  #[test]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  fn e2e_ai_signal_workflow() {                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
      let payload = SignalPayload::new("novai-market-analyzer".to_string(), ...);                                                                                                                                                                 
      let commitment_hash = payload.compute_hash();                                                                                                                                                                                               
      let stored_hash = store.store(&payload.encode()).unwrap();                                                                                                                                                                                  
      let verified = fetch_and_verify_payload(&store, &commitment_hash).expect("success");                                                                                                                                                        
      assert_eq!(verified.compute_hash(), commitment_hash);                                                                                                                                                                                       
  }
