  2. What Went Well                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Clean Module Architecture                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Each module has a single responsibility with explicit documentation of what it does NOT do:                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  //! PURPOSE: Collect mempool, block fullness, and fee trends for congestion forecasting.                                                                                                                                                        
  //! This module is purely observational - it collects data but takes no action.                                                                                                                                                                 
  (congestion_stats.rs:1-4)                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Strong Type System for Congestion Levels                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We implemented a 4-level congestion enum with explicit byte representation for deterministic encoding:                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  #[repr(u8)]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  pub enum CongestionLevel {                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
      Low = 0,      // Normal operation                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      Moderate = 1, // Elevated load                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      High = 2,     // Significant congestion                                                                                                                                                                                                     
      Critical = 3, // Urgent action recommended                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  (congestion_forecaster.rs:17-23)                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Deterministic Integer Math                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  All calculations use integer division to ensure reproducible results across nodes:                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  let fullness = if max_block_txs > 0 {                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      (block_tx_count * 100) / max_block_txs                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  } else { 0 };                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  (congestion_stats.rs:82-86)                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Clear Recommendation Format                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Recommendations include signed percentages and human-readable rationale:

  3. Challenges We Faced                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 1: Borrow Checker Conflict in ResourceTracker                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  When implementing register_budget(), we hit a borrow checker error because we moved budget into the HashMap but then tried to access budget.task_id:                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  // Original code (failed):                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  self.budgets.insert(budget.task_id, budget);                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  self.usage.insert(budget.task_id, ResourceUsage::new());  // Error: budget moved!                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 2: Unused Import Warning                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The CongestionLevel import was only used in test code, causing a compiler warning:                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  use crate::congestion_forecaster::CongestionLevel;  // Warning: unused import                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 3: Pre-existing Clippy Warnings                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Running cargo clippy -D warnings revealed 9 errors across the copilot crate from previous weeks:                                                                                                                                                
  - Manual range contains: assert!(x >= 90 && x <= 110)                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - Useless assert!(true) statements                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  - Missing Default impl for CollectingSpamCallback                                                                                                                                                                                               
  - Unnecessary vec![] macro                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  4. How We Overcame Them                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 1: Extract task_id Before Insert                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We extracted the task_id before moving budget into the HashMap:                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  let task_id = budget.task_id;                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  self.budgets.insert(task_id, budget);                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  self.usage.insert(task_id, ResourceUsage::new());                                                                                                                                                                                               
  (resource_budget.rs:207-209)                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 2: Conditional Compilation for Test Imports                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We marked the import as test-only using #[cfg(test)]:                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  #[cfg(test)]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  use crate::congestion_forecaster::CongestionLevel;                                                                                                                                                                                              
  (congestion_reporter.rs:19)                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 3: Systematic Clippy Fixes                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We fixed all 9 clippy errors systematically:                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Range contains pattern:                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  // Before: assert!(p95 >= 95 && p95 <= 96);                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  // After:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  assert!((95..=96).contains(&p95));                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  (stats.rs:353)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Removed useless assert!(true):                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  // Before: assert!(true, "Tracker is observational only...");                                                                                                                                                                                   
  // After: just a comment explaining the design                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Added Default impl:                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  impl Default for CollectingSpamCallback {                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  (spam_observer.rs)                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Changed vec![] to array:                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  // Before: let patterns = vec![...];                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  // After:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  let patterns = [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
      test_pattern_high_invalid(),                                                                                                                                                                                                                
      test_pattern_high_tx_rate(),                                                                                                                                                                                                                
      // ...                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  ];                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  (spam_reporter.rs:498-503)

Code Evidence                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Evidence 1: Advisory-Only Architecture                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Every module explicitly documents its non-enforcement nature:                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  //! This module is PURELY ADVISORY - it recommends but NEVER auto-applies changes.                                                                                                                                                              
  //! NON-ACTIONS (this module does NOT):                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  //! - Modify chain parameters (MIN_FEE, BLOCK_SIZE_LIMIT)                                                                                                                                                                                       
  //! - Execute any governance actions                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  (congestion_reporter.rs:3-10)                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Payloads include mandatory advisory notice:                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  parts.push(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
      "NOTE: All recommendations are advisory only. No automatic changes are made."                                                                                                                                                               
  );                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  (congestion_reporter.rs:181-183)                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Evidence 2: Integer Math for Determinism                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Mempool growth percentage uses integer division:                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub fn mempool_growth_pct(&self) -> u64 {                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      let avg = self.avg_mempool_size();                                                                                                                                                                                                          
      let current = self.current_mempool_size();                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      if avg == 0 { 100 } else { (current * 100) / avg }                                                                                                                                                                                          
  }

  #[test]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  fn integration_full_pipeline() {                                                                                                                                                                                                                
      // 1. Collect stats                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
      let mut stats = CongestionStats::new(10);                                                                                                                                                                                                   
      for i in 0..5 { stats.record_block(i, 50, 50, 100, 5000, 10); }                                                                                                                                                                             
      stats.record_block(6, 110, 90, 100, 10000, 20);  // Spike!                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      // 2. Generate forecast                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
      let forecast = forecaster.forecast(&stats).expect("Should have data");                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      // 3. Create signal                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
      let (payload, signal) = reporter.create_report(&forecast);                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      // 4. Verify                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
      assert_eq!(signal.signal_type, AiSignalType::CongestionForecast);                                                                                                                                                                           
      assert_eq!(forecast.level, CongestionLevel::High);                                                                                                                                                                                          
      assert_eq!(fee_rec.adjustment_pct, 25);                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  }

## Week 19: Governance Scaffolding and AI Upgrade Policies

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  1. Overview - Objectives & Deliverables                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Week 19 focused on building a complete governance framework for transparent, rule-based protocol upgrades—particularly for managing AI autonomy tier changes. This is critical infrastructure that enables safe progression of AI entities from 
  Advisory to Gated to Autonomous modes.                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Deliverables Completed:                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  - D19.1: Proposal struct with deterministic ID computation                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - D19.2: ProposalType enum (5 variants covering all governance actions)                                                                                                                                                                         
  - D19.3: Proposal lifecycle state machine (6 states with strict transitions)                                                                                                                                                                    
  - D19.4: GovernanceConfig with tiered timelock enforcement                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - D19.5: AuditLogEntry for governance transparency                                                                                                                                                                                              
  - D19.6: AI_AUTONOMY_UPGRADE.md documentation                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Final Metrics:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - New crate: novai-governance                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  - 40 tests passing                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  - ~2,470 lines of code added                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - Zero clippy warnings                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  2. What Went Well                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Clean Architecture with Domain Separation                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We established clear domain separation from the start, using a dedicated domain separator for proposal ID computation:                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  const PROPOSAL_ID_DOMAIN: &[u8] = b"NOVAI_PROPOSAL_ID_V1";                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This prevents cross-domain hash collisions and enables future versioning.                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Risk-Based Timelock Classification                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The tiered timelock system elegantly maps proposal types to appropriate security delays using simple pattern matching:                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub const fn is_high_risk(self) -> bool {                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      matches!(self, Self::ModuleActivation | Self::PolicyChange)                                                                                                                                                                                 
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This classification drives the timelock selection logic:                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  if proposal_type.is_emergency() {                                                                                                                                                                                                               
      self.emergency_timelock_blocks                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  } else if proposal_type.is_high_risk() {                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      self.high_risk_timelock_blocks                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  } else {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      self.default_timelock_blocks                                                                                                                                                                                                                
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Deterministic Encoding with Sorted Approvals                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  To ensure canonical encoding regardless of approval order, we sort approvals before serialization:                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  let mut sorted_approvals = proposal.approvals.clone();                                                                                                                                                                                          
  sorted_approvals.sort_unstable();                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This guarantees identical byte representations for logically equivalent proposals—critical for consensus.                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Comprehensive State Machine                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The proposal lifecycle is clearly documented and enforced with terminal state detection:                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub const fn is_terminal(self) -> bool {                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      matches!(self, Self::Executed | Self::Expired | Self::Rejected)                                                                                                                                                                             
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  3. Challenges We Faced                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 1: Clippy's missing_const_for_fn Warnings                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Several methods couldn't be made const due to using Vec::len() or complex control flow, triggering clippy warnings.                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Example error location: lib.rs:304 - has_threshold() method                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 2: Deterministic Encoding of Optional Fields                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The audit log's optional actor field required careful encoding to maintain determinism while supporting both user-initiated and system-initiated events.                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 3: Versioned Codec Design                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We needed to design encodings that are both compact and forward-compatible, with clear version bytes and length prefixes.                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 4: Pre-existing Clippy Warning in Another Crate                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  When running workspace-wide clippy, we discovered a pre-existing issue in ai_entities/tests/artifact_integration.rs:281:                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  // Original (caused explicit_auto_deref warning)                                                                                                                                                                                                
  let hashes: Vec<[u8; 32]> = contents.iter().map(|c| store.store(*c).unwrap()).collect();                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  4. How We Overcame Them                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 1: Strategic Use of #[allow] Attributes                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  For methods that genuinely cannot be const, we added targeted allows with explanatory comments:                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  #[allow(clippy::missing_const_for_fn)] // Vec::len() is not const stable                                                                                                                                                                        
  pub fn has_threshold(&self, threshold: u32) -> bool {                                                                                                                                                                                           
      self.approvals.len() >= threshold as usize                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 2: Presence Flag for Optional Actor                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We introduced a has_actor byte to handle the optional field deterministically:                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  if let Some(actor) = &entry.actor {                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      out.push(1);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
      out.extend_from_slice(actor);                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  } else {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      out.push(0);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This yields predictable sizes: 79 bytes with actor, 47 bytes without.                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 3: Versioned Format with Length Prefixes                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Both proposal and audit log encodings start with a version byte:                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub const PROPOSAL_CODEC_V1: u8 = 1;                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  pub const AUDIT_LOG_CODEC_V1: u8 = 1;                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Variable-length fields use big-endian u32 length prefixes:                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  out.extend_from_slice(&(proposal_data.len() as u32).to_be_bytes());                                                                                                                                                                             
  out.extend_from_slice(&proposal.proposal_data);                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 4: Fixed Pre-existing Clippy Issue                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Removed unnecessary dereference:                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  // Fixed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  let hashes: Vec<[u8; 32]> = contents.iter().map(|c| store.store(c).unwrap()).collect();                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---

  Deterministic Proposal ID Generation (lib.rs:466-473):                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  let mut hasher = Hasher::new();

  State-Indexed Storage Key (state/lib.rs:212-218):                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub fn governance_proposal_by_state_key(state: u8, proposal_id: &[u8; 32]) -> Vec<u8> {                                                                                                                                                         
      let mut k = Vec::with_capacity(KEY_PREFIX_GOVERNANCE_PROPOSALS_BY_STATE.len() + 1 + 1 + 32);                                                                                                                                                
      k.extend_from_slice(KEY_PREFIX_GOVERNANCE_PROPOSALS_BY_STATE);                                                                                                                                                                              
      k.push(state);                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      k.push(b'/');                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
      k.extend_from_slice(proposal_id);                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      k                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  }

  Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Week 19 successfully delivered a complete governance framework enabling transparent, auditable protocol upgrades with risk-appropriate timelocks. The system provides:                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - Safety: Tiered timelocks (100/1000/5000 blocks) based on proposal risk                                                                                                                                                                        
  - Transparency: Full audit logging with actor attribution                                                                                                                                                                                       
  - Determinism: Canonical encoding with sorted approvals and version bytes                                                                                                                                                                       
  - Queryability: State-indexed storage for efficient proposal lookups                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This infrastructure is essential for the AI autonomy upgrade path, ensuring that any AI tier progression goes through proper governance review with appropriate delay periods.                                                                  


## Week 20: Determinism Fortress and AI Verifiability

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Comprehensive Development Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  1. Week 20 Overview - Objectives & Deliverables                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Mission Statement                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Week 20 focused on establishing bulletproof determinism guarantees across the NOVAI protocol. The goal was to ensure that any two nodes executing the same block sequence will always arrive at identical state roots—a fundamental requirement 
  for blockchain consensus.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Planned Deliverables
