  2. What Went Well                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Clean Architecture Design                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The memory object system follows NOVAI's established patterns for protocol primitives. We defined clear domain separation with a dedicated domain separator for ID computation:                                                                 
  const MEMORY_OBJECT_ID_DOMAIN: &[u8] = b"NOVAI_MEMORY_OBJECT_ID_V1";                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Deterministic ID Generation                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Object IDs are deterministically derived using blake3 hashing, ensuring the same inputs always produce the same ID across all nodes:                                                                                                            
  pub fn compute_id(owner_entity: &[u8; 32], object_type: MemoryObjectType, created_at: u64, data: &[u8]) -> [u8; 32] {                                                                                                                           
      let data_hash = blake3::hash(data);                                                                                                                                                                                                         
      let mut hasher = Hasher::new();                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      hasher.update(MEMORY_OBJECT_ID_DOMAIN);                                                                                                                                                                                                     
      hasher.update(owner_entity);                                                                                                                                                                                                                
      hasher.update(&[object_type.to_byte()]);                                                                                                                                                                                                    
      hasher.update(&created_at.to_be_bytes());                                                                                                                                                                                                   
      hasher.update(data_hash.as_bytes());                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      *hasher.finalize().as_bytes()                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Type-Safe Memory Object Types                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The MemoryObjectType enum provides compile-time safety with explicit byte encoding:                                                                                                                                                             
  #[repr(u8)]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  pub enum MemoryObjectType {                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
      #[default]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      ChainSummary = 0,                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      LabelIndex = 1,                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      EmbeddingCommitment = 2,                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
      AnomalyLog = 3,                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      StatisticsSnapshot = 4,                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Canonical Encoding Format                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  All encoding uses big-endian byte order with explicit version bytes for forward compatibility:                                                                                                                                                  
  /// Format: `[version:1][object_id:32][object_type:1][owner_entity:32]`                                                                                                                                                                         
  ///         `[created_at_be:8][updated_at_be:8][data_len_be:4][data:var]`                                                                                                                                                                       
  pub fn encode_memory_object_v1(obj: &MemoryObject) -> Vec<u8>                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Well-Defined Storage Key Structure                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Storage keys follow NOVAI's hierarchical naming convention:                                                                                                                                                                                     
  pub fn ai_memory_object_key(entity_id: &[u8; 32], object_id: &[u8; 32]) -> Vec<u8> {                                                                                                                                                            
      // Key: b"ai/memory_objects/" ++ entity_id32 ++ "/" ++ object_id32                                                                                                                                                                          
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub fn ai_memory_count_key(entity_id: &[u8; 32]) -> Vec<u8> {                                                                                                                                                                                   
      // Key: b"ai/memory_count/" ++ entity_id32                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  }

  3. Challenges We Faced                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 1: Clippy Derivable Default Implementation                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  When implementing the default value for MemoryObjectType, we initially wrote a manual Default implementation:                                                                                                                                   
  impl Default for MemoryObjectType {                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      fn default() -> Self { Self::ChainSummary }                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  Clippy flagged this as derivable_impls since it could be derived using the #[default] attribute.                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 2: Unused Import Warning                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  After adding the memory payload types to the execution crate, we imported MemoryObjectType but the actual usage was in a different pattern:                                                                                                     
  use novai_ai_entities::MemoryObjectType; // Warning: unused import                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 3: Documentation Missing Backticks                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Clippy's doc_markdown lint flagged our documentation for missing backticks around constants:                                                                                                                                                    
  /// 3. Data size must not exceed MAX_MEMORY_OBJECT_SIZE  // Warning                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 4: Manual Modulo Check                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  When implementing interval-based snapshot creation, we used manual modulo:                                                                                                                                                                      
  if obs_count % self.config.snapshot_interval == 0  // Warning                                                                                                                                                                                   
  Clippy suggested using the newer is_multiple_of method.                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  4. How We Overcame Them                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 1: Using Derive Macro with Attribute                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We changed to derive-based default with the #[default] attribute on the variant:                                                                                                                                                                
  #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]                                                                                                                                                                                     
  pub enum MemoryObjectType {                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
      #[default]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      ChainSummary = 0,                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      // ...                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 2: Removed Unused Import                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The MemoryObjectType was actually used through the payload structs, so we removed the standalone import and used the qualified path:                                                                                                            
  pub object_type: novai_ai_entities::MemoryObjectType,                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 3: Added Backticks to Doc Comments                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We updated all documentation to use proper code formatting:                                                                                                                                                                                     
  /// 3. Data size must not exceed `MAX_MEMORY_OBJECT_SIZE`                                                                                                                                                                                       
  /// 4. Entity must not exceed `MAX_MEMORY_OBJECTS_PER_ENTITY`                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution 4: Used is_multiple_of Method                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We updated to use the Rust 1.80+ is_multiple_of method:                                                                                                                                                                                         
  if self.config.snapshot_interval > 0                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      && obs_count.is_multiple_of(self.config.snapshot_interval)                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---

  pub fn create_statistics_snapshot<S: ObservableState>(&self, state: &S) -> StatisticsSnapshotData {                                                                                                                                             
      StatisticsSnapshotData {                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
          height: state.committed_height(),                                                                                                                                                                                                       
          mempool_size: self.stats.current_mempool_size(),                                                                                                                                                                                        
          validator_count: state.validator_set().len() as u32,                                                                                                                                                                                    
          avg_block_fullness: 50,                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  }

  }

  if self.config.snapshot_interval > 0 && obs_count.is_multiple_of(self.config.snapshot_interval) {                                                                                                                                               
      let snapshot = self.create_statistics_snapshot(state);                                                                                                                                                                                      
      memory_callback.on_statistics_snapshot(MemoryObjectType::StatisticsSnapshot, snapshot.encode());                                                                                                                                            
      self.metrics.record_snapshot();                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  if self.config.summary_interval > 0 && obs_count.is_multiple_of(self.config.summary_interval) {                                                                                                                                                 
      let summary = self.create_chain_summary();                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      memory_callback.on_chain_summary(MemoryObjectType::ChainSummary, summary.encode());                                                                                                                                                         
      self.reset_summary_epoch();                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Test Evidence: Full CRUD Lifecycle (execution/lib.rs:1810-1843)                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  #[test]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  fn create_memory_object_success() {                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      let tx = mk_create_memory_tx(entity.id, 0, 1, MemoryObjectType::ChainSummary, b"chain summary data".to_vec());                                                                                                                              
      let object_id = apply_create_memory_object_tx(&mut db, &tx, 2000).unwrap();                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      let obj = read_memory_object(&db, &entity.id, &object_id).unwrap().expect("Object should exist");                                                                                                                                           
      assert_eq!(obj.object_type, MemoryObjectType::ChainSummary);                                                                                                                                                                                
      assert_eq!(obj.data, b"chain summary data".to_vec());                                                                                                                                                                                       
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Week 21 successfully delivered a complete L1 on-chain memory system for AI entities. The implementation provides:                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  1. Type Safety: 5 distinct memory object types with compile-time checking                                                                                                                                                                       
  2. Determinism: Blake3-based ID generation ensuring cross-node consistency                                                                                                                                                                      
  3. Resource Limits: 64KB per object, 100 objects per entity to prevent abuse                                                                                                                                                                    
  4. Full CRUD: Create, Read, Update, Delete operations with atomic batch writes                                                                                                                                                                  
  5. Automatic Snapshots: Chain Observer integration for periodic summary generation                                                                                                                                                              
  6. 49 New Tests: Comprehensive coverage across 4 crates                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The memory system gives AI entities a native, public, verifiable storage layer—a foundational primitive for future AI capabilities.                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                             


## Week 22: NNPX Privacy Foundation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  1. Week 22 Overview - Objectives & Deliverables                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Goal: Establish the privacy infrastructure for NOVAI using NNPX (Nova Nota Private Exchange) - a subsystem that enables privacy-preserving transactions while maintaining consensus verifiability and ensuring AI entities can never access raw 
  private data.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Deliverables Planned:                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  ┌───────┬──────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐                                                                                                                                  
  │  ID   │         Deliverable          │                             Description                             │                                                                                                                                  
  ├───────┼──────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                                                                                                  
  │ D22.1 │ Privacy Contract Document    │ Formal specification of privacy model, guarantees, and threat model │                                                                                                                                  
  ├───────┼──────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                                                                                                  
  │ D22.2 │ Private Store Separation     │ Physical isolation using RocksDB column families                    │                                                                                                                                  
  ├───────┼──────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                                                                                                  
  │ D22.3 │ PrivatePayloadCommitment     │ Cryptographic commitment structure (129-byte format)                │                                                                                                                                  
  ├───────┼──────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                                                                                                  
  │ D22.4 │ Privacy Boundary Enforcement │ Block AI entities from accessing nnpx/ keys                         │                                                                                                                                  
  ├───────┼──────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                                                                                                  
  │ D22.5 │ Security Unit Tests          │ Prove privacy properties hold                                       │                                                                                                                                  
  └───────┴──────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘                                                                                                                                  
  Core Invariant Established:                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  AI entities NEVER have direct access to raw private data.                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  2. What Went Well                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.1 Clean Architecture for Column Family Separation                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The design elegantly routes keys based on prefix, keeping the Kv trait unchanged:                                                                                                                                                               
  pub const KEY_PREFIX_NNPX: &[u8] = b"nnpx/";                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  pub const CF_NNPX: &str = "nnpx";                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  pub const CF_DEFAULT: &str = "default";                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This allowed both MemKv (testing) and RocksKv (production) to implement the same isolation semantics without trait changes.                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.2 Domain-Separated Cryptographic Hashing                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  All cryptographic operations use domain separation to prevent cross-context attacks:                                                                                                                                                            
  pub const NNPX_COMMITMENT_DOMAIN: &[u8] = b"NOVAI_NNPX_COMMITMENT_V1";                                                                                                                                                                          
  pub const NNPX_NULLIFIER_DOMAIN: &[u8] = b"NOVAI_NNPX_NULLIFIER_V1";                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The commitment hash computation is clean and deterministic:                                                                                                                                                                                     
  pub fn compute_commitment_hash(encrypted_payload: &[u8]) -> [u8; 32] {                                                                                                                                                                          
      let mut hasher = Hasher::new();                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      hasher.update(NNPX_COMMITMENT_DOMAIN);                                                                                                                                                                                                      
      hasher.update(encrypted_payload);                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      *hasher.finalize().as_bytes()                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.3 Compact 129-Byte Encoding Format                                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The PrivatePayloadCommitment has a fixed, canonical encoding:                                                                                                                                                                                   
  pub const PRIVATE_PAYLOAD_COMMITMENT_LEN: usize = 129;                                                                                                                                                                                          
  // Format: [version:1][commitment_hash:32][nullifier:32][encryption_pubkey:32][zk_proof:32]                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.4 Multi-Layer Enforcement Architecture                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Privacy is enforced at three distinct levels:                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Level 1 - Caller Context:                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  pub enum Caller {                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
      Account([u8; 32]),    // Human-controlled                                                                                                                                                                                                   
      AiEntity([u8; 32]),   // AI entity (blocked from NNPX)                                                                                                                                                                                      
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Level 2 - Access Validation:                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  pub fn validate_nnpx_access<E>(key: &[u8], caller: &Caller) -> Result<(), ExecError<E>> {                                                                                                                                                       
      if is_nnpx_key(key) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
          if let Caller::AiEntity(_) = caller {                                                                                                                                                                                                   
              return Err(ExecError::NnpxAccessDenied);                                                                                                                                                                                            
          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      Ok(())                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Level 3 - Capability Validation at Registration:                                                                                                                                                                                                
  pub fn validate_ai_entity_no_nnpx_capability<E>(                                                                                                                                                                                                
      capabilities: &novai_ai_entities::Capabilities,                                                                                                                                                                                             
  ) -> Result<(), ExecError<E>> {                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      if capabilities.read_nnpx_derived {                                                                                                                                                                                                         
          return Err(ExecError::NnpxAccessDenied);                                                                                                                                                                                                
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      Ok(())                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.5 Existing Infrastructure Leveraged                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The Capabilities struct already had read_nnpx_derived: bool from earlier weeks, which simplified the implementation. We just needed to enforce that AI entities never have this capability set to true.                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  3. Challenges We Faced                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.1 MemKv Column Family Simulation                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge: MemKv was a simple Vec of entries. We needed to simulate RocksDB column families without changing the Kv trait interface.                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Evidence of the problem:                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  // OLD: Single vector - no isolation                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  pub struct MemKv {                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      entries: Vec<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)>,                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.2 RocksDB Column Family Migration                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge: Existing databases might not have the nnpx column family. We needed migration support without data loss.                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.3 Clippy Warning for Generic Const Function                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge: Clippy suggested making validate_ai_entity_no_nnpx_capability a const fn, but generic functions cannot be const in stable Rust.                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  warning: this could be a `const fn`                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      --> crates/execution/src/lib.rs:1572:1                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.4 Unused Import After Refactoring                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge: After adding the privacy enforcement, we initially imported KEY_PREFIX_NNPX but ended up only using the is_nnpx_key() helper.                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  4. How We Overcame Them                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.1 MemKv Solution: Dual Entry Vectors                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Split the storage into two logically separate vectors:                                                                                                                                                                                          
  pub struct MemKv {                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      entries_default: Vec<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)>,  // Public chain data                                                                                                                                                                             
      entries_nnpx: Vec<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)>,     // Private data (Week 22)                                                                                                                                                                        
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Added routing based on key prefix:                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  fn entries_for_key(&self, key: &[u8]) -> &Vec<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)> {                                                                                                                                                                             
      if is_nnpx_key(key) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
          &self.entries_nnpx                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
      } else {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
          &self.entries_default                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.2 RocksDB Solution: Automatic CF Creation                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Used RocksDB's create_missing_column_families option:                                                                                                                                                                                           
  opts.create_if_missing(true);                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  opts.create_missing_column_families(true);                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  cf_descriptors.push(ColumnFamilyDescriptor::new(CF_DEFAULT, Options::default()));                                                                                                                                                               
  cf_descriptors.push(ColumnFamilyDescriptor::new(CF_NNPX, Options::default()));                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  let db = DB::open_cf_descriptors(&opts, path, cf_descriptors)?;                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This handles both new databases and migration of existing ones.                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.3 Clippy Warning: Allow Attribute                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Added explicit allow with explanation:                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  #[allow(clippy::missing_const_for_fn)] // Generic functions cannot be const in stable Rust                                                                                                                                                      
  pub fn validate_ai_entity_no_nnpx_capability<E>(                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.4 Unused Import: Removed

  use novai_state::{is_nnpx_key, nnpx_nullifier_key};  // Removed KEY_PREFIX_NNPX
