  6. Code Evidence                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  6.1 Privacy Contract Core Invariant                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  From docs/NNPX_PRIVACY_CONTRACT.md:12:                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  **AI entities NEVER have direct access to raw private data.**                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  6.2 PrivatePayloadCommitment Structure                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  From privacy.rs:74-86:                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  pub struct PrivatePayloadCommitment {                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      pub commitment_hash: [u8; 32],                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      pub nullifier: [u8; 32],                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
      pub encryption_pubkey: [u8; 32],                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      pub zk_proof: [u8; 32],                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  6.3 Nullifier Computation with Counter                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  From privacy.rs:105-111:                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  pub fn compute_nullifier(spending_secret: &[u8; 32], counter: u64) -> [u8; 32] {                                                                                                                                                                
      let mut hasher = Hasher::new();                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      hasher.update(NNPX_NULLIFIER_DOMAIN);                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      hasher.update(spending_secret);                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      hasher.update(&counter.to_be_bytes());                                                                                                                                                                                                      
      *hasher.finalize().as_bytes()                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  }

## Week 23: Derived Views and AI Privacy Bridge

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  1. Week 23 Overview — Objectives & Deliverables                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Primary Objective                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Define a mechanism where "AI may read derived outputs" without privacy leakage. This creates a privacy bridge allowing AI entities to access aggregate/derived data from private transactions without exposing raw NNPX (privacy) data.         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Deliverables Planned                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  ┌───────┬──────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐                                                                                                                      
  │  ID   │       Deliverable        │                                     Description                                     │                                                                                                                      
  ├───────┼──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                                                                                      
  │ D23.1 │ DerivedView Struct       │ Core data structure with view_id, source_type, schema_id, created_at, creator, data │                                                                                                                      
  ├───────┼──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                                                                                      
  │ D23.2 │ Schema Registry          │ Predefined schemas: AggregateVolume, ActivityCount, PoolSize                        │                                                                                                                      
  ├───────┼──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                                                                                      
  │ D23.3 │ Generation Rules         │ DerivedSourceType enum: ChainAggregate, UserAuthorized, ProtocolGenerated           │                                                                                                                      
  ├───────┼──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                                                                                      
  │ D23.4 │ Privacy Budget (Stub)    │ Interface defined but not enforced in Week 23                                       │                                                                                                                      
  ├───────┼──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                                                                                      
  │ D23.5 │ AI Reading Derived Views │ Capability-gated access with audit logging                                          │                                                                                                                      
  ├───────┼──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                                                                                      
  │ D23.6 │ Boundary Tests           │ Tests proving AI can read derived views but NOT raw NNPX                            │                                                                                                                      
  └───────┴──────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘                                                                                                                      
  Acceptance Criteria                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - Derived views created with schema validation                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - AI with read_nnpx_derived capability can read derived views                                                                                                                                                                                   
  - AI still blocked from raw NNPX data                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - Invalid schemas rejected                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  2. What Went Well                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.1 Clean Architecture — Namespace Separation                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We made a critical design decision early: derived views use a completely separate namespace from NNPX private data. This allows clear security boundaries:                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub const KEY_PREFIX_DERIVED_VIEWS: &[u8] = b"derived_views/";                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub const KEY_PREFIX_NNPX: &[u8] = b"nnpx/";                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This means AI entities can read derived_views/ keys while remaining blocked from nnpx/ keys — the existing Week 22 NNPX access control remains untouched.                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.2 Schema-Validated Data Structures                                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We implemented strict schema validation at view creation time, preventing malformed data from entering the system:                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub fn new(...) -> Option<Self> {                                                                                                                                                                                                               
      let schema = DerivedViewSchema::from_id(schema_id)?;                                                                                                                                                                                        
      if !schema.validate_data(&data) {                                                                                                                                                                                                           
          return None;                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      // ...                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Each schema enforces exact data lengths:                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  pub const fn expected_data_len(&self) -> Option<usize> {                                                                                                                                                                                        
      match self {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
          Self::AggregateVolume => Some(32), // 8 + 8 + 16                                                                                                                                                                                        
          Self::ActivityCount => Some(24),   // 8 + 8 + 8                                                                                                                                                                                         
          Self::PoolSize => Some(24),        // 8 + 16                                                                                                                                                                                            
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.3 Deterministic View IDs                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Following established patterns, view IDs are content-addressed using domain-separated blake3 hashing:                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  const DERIVED_VIEW_ID_DOMAIN: &[u8] = b"NOVAI_DERIVED_VIEW_ID_V1";                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub fn compute_id(...) -> [u8; 32] {                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      let mut hasher = Hasher::new();                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      hasher.update(DERIVED_VIEW_ID_DOMAIN);                                                                                                                                                                                                      
      hasher.update(&[source_type.to_byte()]);                                                                                                                                                                                                    
      hasher.update(&schema_id.to_be_bytes());                                                                                                                                                                                                    
      // ...                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
      *hasher.finalize().as_bytes()                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.4 Comprehensive Index System                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We implemented three indices for efficient querying:                                                                                                                                                                                            
  - Primary storage: derived_views/{view_id32}                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - Schema index: derived_views/by_schema/{schema_id_be4}/{view_id32}                                                                                                                                                                             
  - Creator index: derived_views/by_creator/{creator32}/{view_id32}                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub fn write_derived_view_ops(view: &DerivedView) -> Vec<WriteOp> {                                                                                                                                                                             
      let mut ops = Vec::with_capacity(3);                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      ops.push(WriteOp::Put(primary_key, encoded));                                                                                                                                                                                               
      ops.push(WriteOp::Put(schema_key, vec![])); // Presence index                                                                                                                                                                               
      ops.push(WriteOp::Put(creator_key, vec![])); // Presence index                                                                                                                                                                              
      ops                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.5 Audit Logging Built-In                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Every AI read of a derived view creates an audit trail:                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub fn create_derived_view_audit_entry(                                                                                                                                                                                                         
      entity_id: &[u8; 32],                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      view_id: &[u8; 32],                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
      height: u64,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
  ) -> WriteOp {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      let key = derived_view_audit_key(entity_id, height);                                                                                                                                                                                        
      WriteOp::Put(key, view_id.to_vec())                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  3. Challenges We Faced                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.1 Capability Integration                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The existing Capabilities struct already had read_nnpx_derived defined but was blocked from being set (Week 22 actively rejected it). We needed to change this semantic:                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Before (Week 22): read_nnpx_derived was forbidden on AI entities                                                                                                                                                                                
  After (Week 23): read_nnpx_derived grants access to derived_views/ only                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This required understanding the existing validation:                                                                                                                                                                                            
  pub fn validate_ai_entity_no_nnpx_capability<E>(                                                                                                                                                                                                
      capabilities: &novai_ai_entities::Capabilities,                                                                                                                                                                                             
  ) -> Result<(), ExecError<E>> {                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      if capabilities.read_nnpx_derived {                                                                                                                                                                                                         
          return Err(ExecError::NnpxAccessDenied);                                                                                                                                                                                                
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      Ok(())                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.2 Maintaining Privacy Boundary Integrity                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The key challenge was ensuring that even with the new read_nnpx_derived capability, AI entities remain completely blocked from raw NNPX data. We needed to prove this boundary wasn't weakened.                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.3 Clippy Warnings                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Initial implementation triggered several clippy warnings:                                                                                                                                                                                       
  - missing_const_for_fn on generic validation function                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - doc_markdown warnings for WriteOp references                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - field_reassign_with_default in test helpers                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  - redundant_clone in test code                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  4. How We Overcame Them                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.1 Separate Validation Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We created a new validation function specifically for derived views, leaving the NNPX validation unchanged:                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub fn validate_derived_view_access<E>(                                                                                                                                                                                                         
      entity: &novai_ai_entities::AiEntity,                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  ) -> Result<(), ExecError<E>> {                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      if !entity.capabilities.read_nnpx_derived {                                                                                                                                                                                                 
          return Err(ExecError::DerivedViewAccessDenied);                                                                                                                                                                                         
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      Ok(())                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The existing validate_nnpx_access function continues to block ALL AI entities from nnpx/ keys, regardless of capabilities.                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.2 Boundary Test Proving Security                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We added an explicit test proving the security boundary remains intact:                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  #[test]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  fn ai_cannot_read_raw_nnpx_even_with_derived_capability() {                                                                                                                                                                                     
      let entity = create_entity_with_derived_capability();                                                                                                                                                                                       
      let ai_caller = Caller::AiEntity(entity.id);                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      let nnpx_key = b"nnpx/commitments/secret123";                                                                                                                                                                                               
      let result: Result<(), ExecError<()>> = validate_nnpx_access(nnpx_key, &ai_caller);                                                                                                                                                         
      assert!(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
          matches!(result, Err(ExecError::NnpxAccessDenied)),                                                                                                                                                                                     
          "AI must STILL be blocked from raw NNPX even with derived capability"                                                                                                                                                                   
      );                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.3 Clippy Fixes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Fixed all warnings with targeted changes:                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  // Suppressed const warning on generic function                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  #[allow(clippy::missing_const_for_fn)]                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  pub fn validate_derived_view_access<E>(...) -> Result<(), ExecError<E>>                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  // Used struct initialization instead of field reassignment                                                                                                                                                                                     
  let caps = Capabilities {                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      read_nnpx_derived: true,                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
      read_public_chain: true,                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
      ..Capabilities::default()                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  };

  8. Architectural Significance                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Week 23 establishes a critical privacy bridge pattern:                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  1. Raw private data (nnpx/) remains completely inaccessible to AI entities                                                                                                                                                                      
  2. Derived aggregates (derived_views/) are accessible with proper capability                                                                                                                                                                    
  3. Audit trail ensures all AI reads are logged                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4. Schema validation ensures data integrity                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  5. Privacy budget stub prepares for rate-limiting in future weeks                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This creates a safe pathway for AI entities to observe chain-level statistics without compromising individual transaction privacy — a key requirement for privacy-preserving AI integration.                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                               


## Week 24: AI-Era Testnet Launch

Week 24 Overview - Objectives & Deliverables
