  2. What Went Well                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.1 Clean Architecture for Module Lifecycle                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We added a single boolean field to control the entire module lifecycle:                                                                                                                                                                         
  pub struct AiEntity {                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      // ... existing fields ...                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      pub is_active: bool,  // Set via governance proposals                                                                                                                                                                                       
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  This simple design enables powerful governance control without complex state machines.                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.2 Versioned Codec with Backward Compatibility                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The V1/V2 codec design elegantly handles migration:                                                                                                                                                                                             
  pub const AI_ENTITY_V1: u8 = 0x01;  // 203 bytes, no is_active                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub const AI_ENTITY_V2: u8 = 0x02;  // 204 bytes, includes is_active                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  V1 entities decode with a sensible default:                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  is_active: true,  // V1 backward compat: default to active                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.3 Well-Known Module Identifiers                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Core Observer has deterministic, auditable identifiers:                                                                                                                                                                                         
  pub const CORE_OBSERVER_CODE_HASH: CodeHash = [                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      0x53, 0x1c, 0xc2, 0xd3, ...  // blake3("NOVAI_CORE_OBSERVER_V1")                                                                                                                                                                            
  ];                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  pub const PROTOCOL_CREATOR: Address = [                                                                                                                                                                                                         
      0x5e, 0x04, 0x3a, 0x2b, ...  // blake3("NOVAI_PROTOCOL_GENESIS_V1")                                                                                                                                                                         
  ];                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This allows anyone to independently verify the Core Observer's identity.                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.4 TimelockOnly Gate Simplifies Testnet                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  For testnet simplicity, we used a zero-threshold gate that auto-approves:                                                                                                                                                                       
  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
    "gate_type": "timelock_only",                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
    "threshold": 0,                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
    "timelock_blocks": 100                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  2.5 Comprehensive Test Coverage                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Created 20 new tests covering the full governance lifecycle:                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - 10 tests in core_observer_e2e.rs                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  - 9 tests in governance_e2e.rs                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - 1 comprehensive test in rollback_workflow_d24_5.rs                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  3. Challenges We Faced                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.1 Incompatible AI Entity Encodings                                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Problem: The execution crate had its own 171-byte encoding while the codec crate used 203-byte V1 format. This caused silent data corruption.                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Symptom: Tests would pass locally but entity data would be unreadable across modules.                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.2 Missing KvBatch Method                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Problem: Initial implementation used db.write() which doesn't exist on the KvBatch trait.                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Error:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  error[E0599]: no method named `write` found for mutable reference                                                                                                                                                                               
  `&mut K` in the current context                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.3 TimelockOnly Auto-Approval Timing                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Problem: Auto-approval was happening at execution time instead of submission time. This meant the timelock countdown never started properly for zero-threshold gates.                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Symptom: Proposals that should be executable after 10 blocks remained stuck in "Submitted" state forever.                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.4 Test Expecting Wrong Error Type                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Problem: The decode_rejects_short_buffer test passed a buffer of all zeros, but byte 0 (0x00) is not a valid version, so it returned InvalidVersion(0) instead of BufferTooShort.                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Original test:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  let short = vec![0u8; 100];  // First byte is 0x00 = invalid version                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  3.5 Missing Dependency                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Problem: The execution crate needed to call governance functions but didn't have the dependency declared.                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Error:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  error[E0432]: unresolved import `novai_governance`                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  4. How We Overcame Them                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.1 Unified Encoding Through Codec Crate                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution: Removed the local 171-byte encoding and used the codec crate's unified functions:                                                                                                                                                     
  use novai_codec::{decode_ai_entity, encode_ai_entity_v2};                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub fn write_ai_entity_op(entity: &AiEntity) -> WriteOp {                                                                                                                                                                                       
      let value = encode_ai_entity_v2(entity);  // Uses codec crate                                                                                                                                                                               
      WriteOp::Put(key, value)                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.2 Using apply_batch Instead of write                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution: Changed to the correct trait method:                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  // Before (wrong):                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  db.write(&[op])?;                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  // After (correct):                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  db.apply_batch(&[op]).map_err(ExecError::Db)?;                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.3 Auto-Approve at Submission Time                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution: Moved auto-approval logic from execute to submit:                                                                                                                                                                                     
  pub fn apply_governance_submit_tx<K: KvBatch>(...) -> Result<[u8; 32], ...> {                                                                                                                                                                   
      // For TimelockOnly gates (threshold == 0): auto-approve immediately                                                                                                                                                                        
      if gate.threshold == 0 {                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
          proposal.approve(current_height, gate.timelock_blocks)?;                                                                                                                                                                                
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      // ... store proposal                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  This ensures the timelock countdown starts at submission.                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.4 Fixed Test with Valid Version Byte                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution: Set the first byte to a valid version before testing buffer length:                                                                                                                                                                   
  let mut short = vec![0u8; 100];                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  short[0] = AI_ENTITY_V2;  // Valid version, but insufficient length                                                                                                                                                                             
  let result = decode_ai_entity(&short);                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  assert_eq!(result, Err(AiEntityCodecError::BufferTooShort));                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  4.5 Added Missing Dependency                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Solution: Added to crates/execution/Cargo.toml:                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  novai-governance = { path = "../governance", version = "0.1.0" }                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---

Code Evidence                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  6.1 Module Lifecycle Control                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  The is_active field controls whether a module can operate:                                                                                                                                                                                      
  pub is_active: bool,  // ai_entities/src/lib.rs:233                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  6.2 Activation Function                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Simple, idempotent activation:                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  pub fn apply_module_activation<K: KvBatch>(db: &mut K, entity_id: &[u8; 32])                                                                                                                                                                    
      -> Result<(), ExecError<K::Error>> {                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      let mut entity = read_ai_entity(db, entity_id)?.ok_or(ExecError::EntityNotFound)?;                                                                                                                                                          
      if !entity.is_active {                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
          entity.is_active = true;                                                                                                                                                                                                                
          db.apply_batch(&[write_ai_entity_op(&entity)]).map_err(ExecError::Db)?;                                                                                                                                                                 
      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      Ok(())                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  (execution/src/lib.rs:906-920)                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  6.3 Rollback Function                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Mirror of activation for deactivation:                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  if entity.is_active {                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      entity.is_active = false;                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
      // ... save to DB                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  (execution/src/lib.rs:937-940)

  Proposals check timelock before execution:                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  if !proposal.can_execute_at(current_height) {                                                                                                                                                                                                   
      return Err(ExecError::ProposalNotExecutable);                                                                                                                                                                                               
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  (execution/src/lib.rs:1120-1122)

  Third-party modules start inactive by design:                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  entity.is_active = false;  // CRITICAL: Third-party starts inactive                                                                                                                                                                             
  (rollback_workflow_d24_5.rs:68)

  apply_signal_commitment_tx(&mut db, &tx, 1000)?;

## Week 25: Adversarial Governance Testing

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  1. Week 25 Overview - Objectives & Deliverables                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Week Goal: Break the approval gates and attempt unauthorized actions through comprehensive adversarial testing of the NOVAI governance system.                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Planned Deliverables:                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - A25.1: Proposal Spam - Test resource exhaustion and rate limiting                                                                                                                                                                             
  - A25.2: Approval Replay - Attempt to reuse/manipulate approvals                                                                                                                                                                                
  - A25.3: Timelock Bypass - Execute proposals before timelock elapsed                                                                                                                                                                            
  - A25.4: Tier 0 Execution - Execute forbidden actions through governance                                                                                                                                                                        
  - A25.5: Executor Reentrancy - Exploit state manipulation during execution                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Final Output:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  - 40 adversarial tests across 5 test suites                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  - 2,750 lines of security-focused test code                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  - 2 critical vulnerabilities discovered and patched                                                                                                                                                                                             
  - 2 new error types added to execution engine                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  - Complete documentation in ADVERSARIAL_GOVERNANCE_REPORT.md                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  2. What Went Well                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Clean Attack Surface Identification                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  We systematically identified attack vectors by analyzing the governance flow. The module docstrings clearly defined our attack methodology:                                                                                                     
  //! ATTACK VECTORS:                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  //! - Replay approvals from one proposal to another                                                                                                                                                                                             
  //! - Resubmit proposals to inherit previous approvals                                                                                                                                                                                          
  This structured approach ensured comprehensive coverage.                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Deterministic Testing Infrastructure                                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  All tests used deterministic proposal ID computation, enabling reproducible attack scenarios:                                                                                                                                                   
  let expected_id = Proposal::compute_id(                                                                                                                                                                                                         
      ProposalType::ParamChange,                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      &proposer,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      &timelock_gate_id(),                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      &data,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  );

  3. Challenges We Faced                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 1: Proposal Resubmission Timing Reset                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Discovery: During A25.2 testing, we found that resubmitting a proposal could reset its approval timing:                                                                                                                                         
  if new_proposal.executable_at > original_executable_at {                                                                                                                                                                                        
      println!("WARNING: Resubmission RESET approval timing!");                                                                                                                                                                                   
  Severity: Critical - An attacker could indefinitely delay proposal execution by resubmitting.                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 2: Expired Proposal Resurrection                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Discovery: Expired proposals (non-terminal state) could be resubmitted as fresh proposals, bypassing the expiry mechanism entirely.                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 3: Tier 0 Action Embedding                                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Discovery: During A25.4 testing, we found Tier 0 actions could be embedded in ParamChange/PolicyChange payloads:                                                                                                                                
  fn encode_consensus_rule_change() -> Vec<u8> {                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      let mut data = Vec::new();                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      data.push(ActionType::ModifyConsensusRule.to_byte()); // Action type byte                                                                                                                                                                   
      data.extend_from_slice(b"CHANGE_FINALITY_THRESHOLD=1");                                                                                                                                                                                     
      data                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  Severity: Critical - Could allow AI entities to modify consensus rules.                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 4: Test Pattern Consistency                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Discovery: Initial test file drafts used incorrect patterns (e.g., &MemKv instead of &mut MemKv, wrong TxV1 field names). Required revision to match existing codebase patterns.                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Challenge 5: KvBatch Trait Not In Scope                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Error encountered: no method named 'apply_batch' found for mutable reference '&mut MemKv'                                                                                                                                                       
  Required adding the correct trait import to each test file.

  Only terminal states (Executed, Rejected) allow resubmission.   Fix 2: Tier0ActionForbidden Error (A25.4 Hardening)

      if let Some(&first_byte) = payload.proposal_data.first() {                                                                                                                                                                                  
          if first_byte == ActionType::ModifyConsensusRule.to_byte()                                                                                                                                                                              
              || first_byte == ActionType::ModifyStateTransition.to_byte()

We discovered 4 vulnerabilities (2 critical) and patched them with 2 new error types and 3 validation checks. The final system provides:            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - Integrity: Proposals cannot be manipulated after submission

  NOVAI Week 26: Adversarial Privacy Testing - Complete Summary
